summary:
# NOTES: "The Boy Traders; Or, The Sportsman's Club Among the Boers" (Harry Castlemon, Frank Nelson Series, 1877; Gutenberg #56868)

Single book. Chapters I–XVII, plus advertising page at end and transcriber's notes.

## Characters
- **Frank Nelson**: young captain/sailing master; cousin of Archie. Frank was "shanghaied" earlier, rose to command of whaler Tycoon. Calm, thoughtful, acts as navigator. Has a Maynard (rifle). Gets crowbait horse and heavy elephant gun (no. 3 lot).
- **Uncle Dick (Captain Dick Gaylord? — called "Uncle Dick", captain of the Stranger)**: old sailor, owner/captain, jolly, stern when needed, meerschaum pipe, speaking-trumpet. Uncle of Walter & Eugene Gaylord.
- **Walter Gaylord**: paymaster, keeps books and key of safe; older brother of Eugene. Had been captured earlier by robbers.
- **Eugene Gaylord**: younger, flute player, new Henry rifle, sixteen-shooter; brave/boastful.
- **Archie Winters**: cousin of Frank; daring, witty, backwoods-spirited; lassoed wild horse; disarmed convict Waters alone while asleep (irons), later recaptured ship. Maynard rifle; silver-mounted rifle and thoroughbred horse in lottery (but drew it).
- **Fred Craven**, **George Le Dell**, **Henry Chase**, **Leonard Wilson** (Chase & Wilson stayed in Bellville), **Jasper Babcock**, **Phil Perkins** ("Perk"), **Featherweight** (nickname), Club members.
- **Dick Lewis**: backwoods trapper, huge strength, Indian yells, quick as lightning; fought Waters. **Bob Kelly**: his companion trapper, old.
- **Mack (McGregor)**: Scotch ex-transport-rider, wagon driver; stole Uncle Dick's double-barrel and Walter's horse/gun; deserted; sold stolen horse/gun in Grahamstown.
- **Waters**: escaped English convict, giant, bully; "Stand by me, mates!"; struck Lucas, Barton, Rodgers, Doctor; put in brig; later with Bob and Fowler seized Stranger.
- **Fowler**: consul's clerk (Mr. Fowler, "Gus"), affected English drawl, gold eyeglass; conspired with convicts.
- **Bob** (ticket-of-leave convict, rich through hauling goods); **Brown** (repentant sailor, one of three foremast hands; also Stevens, Brown, the three).
- **Mr. Baldwin**: first mate. **Mr. Parker**: second mate. **Barton**: boatswain's coxswain. **Lucas**: old boatswain's mate. **Rodgers**. **Doctor**: negro cook. **Perk**. **Old Neptune**.
- **Mr. Wilbur**: sheep-herder, fellow miner of Uncle Dick, hospitable; station near Hobart Town.
- **Mynheer Schrader**: surly Boer farmer and field cornet/magistrate.
- **Kendall**: midshipman; **gray-headed lieutenant** of steamer.
- **Kaffirs** (four servants; cook deserts with Mack's help); **Griquas**; **Zulus** (chief, medicine-man scare by Dick).
- **Kanaker**: Hawaiian swimmer who spoke English.
- **Waters' companions**: convicts (Bob the ticket-of-leave man, the other convict).
- **Pike**, **Potter**, **Zack and Silas** (earlier series references); **Boson** (third mate of Tycoon); **Captain Barclay**; **Mr. Gale**; **Colonel Gaylord** (owner of wild horse; Walter/Eugene's father, Mr. Gaylord, plantation near Bellville).
- Mr. Gaylord (father): planter; Mrs. Gaylord; old Sam.

## Vessels
- **Stranger**: schooner, Uncle Dick's; armed with thirty-pounder "Long Tom" (thrown overboard in storm), twenty-four pounders (Dahlgren), shrapnel; holiday flag; signal-chest; brig.
- **Tycoon**: whaler Frank commanded.
- **Sea Gull**: English ship wrecked near Pacific island (from Hobart Town/Melbourne). Eleven rescued.
- **Banner**: Uncle Dick's old ship (Perk was cook there); smuggler-related reference.
- English steamer, war-steamer (lieutenant/midshipman).
- Tug (Club rescued them at Hobart).
- Sea: "Herald" newspaper (Chase's letter).

## Places
- Sandwich Islands: Honolulu (Oahu; Father Damon's seaman's chapel), Hilo (Hawaii island), Kilauea volcano (Volcano House), Captain Cook's bay.
- Mangrove Islands: scene of fight with natives; Frank burned village; natives attacked.
- Pacific cyclone: Frank's lesson (rotary, progressive; southern hemisphere rotation).
- Island where Sea Gull wrecked; Stranger driven onto reef, dismantled, anchored near shore, Long Tom lost.
- Hobart Town, Van Diemen's Land (Tasmania): convict settlement; police; consul at Hobart.
- Mr. Wilbur's station (Tasmania); river anchorage; Melbourne, Bendigo mines (Uncle Dick mined there; ounce of gold bribe to man-hunter).
- Natal; Grahamstown (outfit purchase from English colonel's agent); Boer settlement (Schrader's farm); "lion veldt" valley with fountain & shooting-hole; Griqua village; Zulu country beyond desert; Bushmen.
- Bellville (Club home town; Gaylord plantation, wharves), Lawrence (Frank's home), New Orleans, Memphis, Galveston, St. Louis, Washita River, Rangeley Lakes, Adirondacks, Florida orange plantation, Lost Island.

## Events in order
1. Ch I: Frank and Uncle Dick quiz re: barometer, cyclone. Summary of earlier adventures; Sandwich Islands visit: Honolulu, Hilo surf-board; Archie/Eugene bluff about surf; Volcano House night (trappers terrified); trappers decide to go on.
2. Ch II: Mangroves; Frank fires thirty-pounder at ambush; cyclone approaches; gale; boys battened in cabin; schooner dismasted, Frank orders on deck; Waters? no—gale ends after a night.
3. Ch III: Cyclone warning; Mr. Baldwin explains hurricane; wind shifts; Stranger driven ashore on island; Long Tom thrown overboard; passage through reef; natives' canoes attacked with shrapnel (four boats emptied).
4. Ch IV: Ship (Sea Gull) wrecked on reef; eleven saved; Waters/convicts identified (four suspected escaped convicts; Waters giant). Frank gets watch; Waters as "Waters."
5. Ch V: Waters' insolence; strikes Lucas; seizes handspike; Dick Lewis defeats him; put in irons; three friends chastised. Club wagers on Dick vs horse race.
6. Ch VI: Refit complete; sail to Hobart Town; convicts identified; consul's clerk Fowler arrives, interference; police take convicts; Uncle Dick's bribe story; Club's dinner with Englishmen; Archie's bogus America talk.
7. Ch VII: Mr. Wilbur's station; race: Dick beats Eugene's horse (Dick gave flying start); Australia trip; Archie's horse stolen by bushrangers; Fowler questions Frank about safe, navigation; Stranger goes to river; Fowler stays with Frank; Frank locked in cabin; schooner under way.
8. Ch VIII: Frank released by Bob; Waters & Fowler; plan revealed (Fowler and Bob; Walter the target; Archie captured instead); Frank forced to command; crew (Brown, Stevens, Doctor) seized; convicts' history.
9. Ch IX: Fowler tries to lure Walter down lane; Bob captures Archie by mistake; Frank conversation with Waters; Frank's Yankee trick evades steamer at night; Archie's "I wasn't born" line; Archie drugs/irons Waters asleep (Waters sleeps "like a log").
10. Ch X: Archie irons Waters; recapture of Stranger; Bob, Stevens, Brown secure others; Waters, Fowler irons; Frank's precautions; steamer (English) intercepts; flag exchange; midshipman Kendall; gray-headed lieutenant.
11. Ch XI: Lieutenant and Kendall; Brown ordered to haul down flag, refused; tug arrives with Club; Uncle Dick explains; three foremast hands discharged; Stranger sails to Natal.
12. Ch XII: Land at Natal; Uncle Dick buys outfit from colonel's agent at Grahamstown (wagon, six span? oxen, salted horses, elephant guns); lottery for horses/rifles (Frank #3 = crowbait & heavy gun; Archie = thoroughbred & silver-mounted rifle); Kaffir servants; trek; Boers' ruinous hospitality.
13. Ch XIII: Schrader refuses trade; Frank repairs native's gun; Schrader's anger; lion veldt warnings; Eugene dares Fred & Archie to stay at fountain.
14. Ch XIV: Night in shooting-pit; jackal yelps; lions "troop" shot—wild dogs; Fred, Eugene, Archie fire 39 shots.
15. Ch XV: Discovery: wild dog; Mack suspicious; Archie's horse found in thorn-bush grove; Mack's odd behavior; Uncle Dick plans watch.
16. Ch XVI: Mack steals Walter's horse & Uncle Dick's double-barrel; Kaffirs desert; Eugene discovers Mack lied; trek without driver; Walter drives; Zulu envoy demands guns; Dick's Indian yells and dance frighten chief.
17. Ch XVII: Zulus lured back; Griquas desert; Zulu ambush at dry stream; trappers' horses killed; Archie's horse dies; Frank saves Archie; Frank hit by spear (haversack saved him); fight won; Boers trade; Mack sold stolen horse/gun, fled.
Return home: Lost Island, Bellville, Gaylord plantation; Christmas festivities; cousins to New Orleans, Lawrence; Epilogue: Frank a lawyer; Archie civil engineer, married; Fred revenue lieutenant; Jasper Babcock cotton factor; George Le Dell in Memphis (Archie's brother-in-law); Perkins steamers; Walter & Eugene run plantation; Uncle Dick at cabin; Banner & Stranger still exist.

## Key quotes
- "Human natur'!" (Dick Lewis)
- "Stand by me, mates!" (Waters)
- "I wasn't born." (Archie, on helping in Yankee trick)
- "Don't all speak at once, because I don't want too much company." (Eugene)
- "Where's my horse?" (chapter XV title)
- "We're deserted." (Uncle Dick)
- "I wants nothing." (Schrader)

## Transcriber notes
Advertising page moved to end; typos silently corrected; spellings retained; italics as _underscores_, bold as =equals=.
